senses.gloss: m. (Inf. Hif. of שׁוּב) restoring, giving back.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:6">B. Mets. III, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 38a">38ᵃ</cite>) <he>מפני ה׳ אבידה</he> Ms. M. a. Y. ed. (ed. <he>מפני שהוא כמשיב</he>) because the taking care of a trust comes under the duty of restoring a neighbor’s lost property; Y. Yeb. II, end, 4ᵇ; a. e.; v. <cite ref="E00910">next w.</cite>
